register.labelZh: KEY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: key into a system 表示進入系統;key information in 則表示輸入資料。；談論密碼、個人號碼、網上表格和電腦紀錄時,你可以使用 KEY 片語動詞。；key something to something 可以表示課堂、計劃、服務或時間表是按照特定對象或目的而設計的。；這些表達可見於電腦指示、辦公室、學校、預訂系統和客戶服務等情境。
register.summaryEn: Key into a system describes gaining access to it, while key information in describes typing the information. You can use KEY expressions when talking about passwords, personal numbers, online forms and computer records. Key something to something helps you explain that a lesson, plan, service or timetable has been designed for a particular group or purpose. These expressions may appear in computer instructions, offices, schools, booking systems and customer services.
